devicesMFE.py.summary: This class models the DevicesMFE page, providing methods to verify and interact with various UI elements such as device cards, navigation icons, printer devices, and application window controls. It includes platform-specific handling, composite verification logic, retry mechanisms, and advanced interaction techniques like keyboard shortcuts, coordinate-based clicking, and screenshot comparison for visual regression testing. The class is structured to ensure robust UI automation and consistent element state validation across different environments.
